verdict.rationale: Convex provides a managed place to write server functions with client libraries ([convex-docs-40], [convex-docs-62]). Public functions are exposed at HTTP endpoints that return results ([convex-docs-9], [convex-docs-31]), and custom HTTP actions are defined in convex/http.ts ([convex-docs-56]). SDKs cover JavaScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin and Rust ([convex-docs-42]), and the CLI pushes functions to the deployment automatically and can invoke them ([convex-docs-17], [convex-docs-18]), with nothing to set up ([convex-docs-2]). Missing for 10: an explicit production-deploy workflow (only dev push is evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the serverless function experience.
